effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH (0x4200…0006 on Base) to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault spends `assets` of the signer's WETH allowance to the vault.
The vault mints shares of 9SETHc to `receiver`, in a number it computes from total assets and total supply (rounded down).
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", with the WETH amount deposited, a constant share ticker 9SETHc, and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many 9SETHc shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Descriptor shows only `Share ticker` raw constant "9SETHc", no share amount.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name the asset or the receiver; no interpolated sentence.
findings.evidence: Descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit"; fields `Deposit asset`, `Send shares to`.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} for 9SETHc shares to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends WETH to the vault in an amount the vault computes from total assets and total supply (rounded up); no maximum is in the calldata.
The vault spends that WETH amount from the signer's allowance to the vault.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", the constant "Deposit asset: WETH" without an amount, the share amount minted in 9SETHc, and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much WETH leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor: field `Deposit asset` = `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` (raw, no amount).

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say WETH is paid from the signer's wallet.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit WETH to mint vault shares" and add an interpolatedIntent with {shares} and {receiver}.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
The vault burns shares of 9SETHc from `owner`, in a number it computes (rounded up).
When `owner` is not the signer, the vault spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact WETH amount, the recipient and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many 9SETHc shares the owner burns; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Descriptor has no share field.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: When `owner` is not the signer, the vault spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`, in an amount it computes from storage (rounded down), with no minimum in the calldata.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the share amount in 9SETHc, the recipient and the owner; nothing names WETH as the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets; only shares and addresses are shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(...); _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);` Descriptor redeem fields: `Shares to redeem`, `To`, `Owner`; no underlying asset field, while mint has `{"label": "Deposit asset", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem shares for WETH".

findings.title: redeem does not show the WETH amount received; the vault computes it and has no minimum.
